answer.instruction: Answer from HHS4185 course materials first and label any Davidson supplementation.
answer.language_rule: Use English-only derived course-material records and preserve English bullet, arrow, line-break, and indentation structure. The raw bilingual layer is retained for provenance and is not used for ordinary retrieval.

source_quotations.instruction: Use quotation_candidates from the retrieval packet; preserve the extracted wording until the source PDF page image is checked.

references.course_materials: HHS4185 course materials, PDF filename, slide N (PDF p. N)
references.supplemental_davidson: Davidson's Principles and Practice of Medicine, 25th ed., Chapter N, p. N [PDF p. N]

visuals.instruction: Use visual_reference_candidates for location/name metadata. Use full table reconstruction only when table_reconstruction_included is true; do not invent non-table visual content.

verification.instruction: Generated quotations, tables, summaries, keywords, and visual mappings require manual source-page verification before clinical reliance.
